messages.text: Product wants Notion AI in the team workspace for drafting specs. Not a coding tool. Can we reuse the Cursor approval?

Org controls carry: no customer PII, company SSO, 6-month prompt logs, internal use, named owner. Cursor's DPA is Anysphere, not Notion. Notion AI is not a code tool so the no-training-on-code clause does not apply here — do not pretend it does.
Notion DPA signed (file PROC-DPA-NOTION-2026-06). Workspace SSO on. No code-retention schedule because this is documents, not a repository.

Legal signs Notion AI for Product, owner Shirley Xue, internal workspace drafting only. Same five org controls as Cursor. Vendor DPA is Notion's. This approval is not evidence that a coding vendor may keep our source.
